Chapter 1413 - 1: Information From A Past Timeline

Chapter 1413: Chapter 1: Information from a Past Timeline

In the dimensional rift, Wan Chengkong and Mother of the Screw Realm sat across from each other, sipping fine wine as they chatted.

As Second Realm time lifeforms in this area of the dimensional rift,

Wan Chengkong and Mother of the Screw Realm stood at the pinnacle, renowned among the surrounding time lifeforms.

Second Realm time lifeforms, though unlike Time Lords, lacked the means to utterly annihilate time lifeforms.

Yet, few First Realm time lifeforms dared to provoke, making enemies with Second Realm time lifeforms, risking death or relentless pursuit.

"Who would have thought that ’Galaxy’ is a time lifeform within the dimensional space? Without even experiencing a great apocalypse, already a Second Realm?"

Wan Chengkong’s expression was wistful.

Recently, the Milky Way dimension produced a Third Realm lord material, attracting two Second Realm time lifeforms to compete over it.

One Second Realm time lifeform, named ’Gray Ancestor,’ came from a distant rift region, familiar to Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong.

But another Second Realm time lifeform, ’Galaxy’? Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong had no impression of it.

Originally, they thought ’Galaxy’ came from an even more distant dimensional rift region, thus unknown to them.

As for why the time lifeform in the Chaos Void could invite such a Second Realm time lifeform...

Perhaps it was a fortuitous encounter, or for other reasons, speculated Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong.

They weren’t very surprised.

But as the Milky Way dimension was taken over by the Chaos Void dimension, news of ’Galaxy’ spread.

This Second Realm ’Galaxy’ was also from the Chaos Void.

This left Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong a bit dumbfounded, not knowing how many eras and hardships they endured after their home dimensional space’s great apocalypse, constantly strategizing against other time lifeforms, analyzing various timelines.

Only then did they finally manage to comprehend their own Chaotic Origin Dao and step into the Second Realm.

And yet ’Galaxy’ was already Second Realm within their home dimensional space?

Wan Chengkong felt somewhat uneasy, having recently sought out Lin Yuan, hoping to collaborate on exploring a special dimensional space.

However, Lin Yuan had yet to respond, leaving Wan Chengkong somewhat disappointed.

"Encountering a time lifeform that entered the Second Realm within a great apocalypse cycle is truly unbelievable," said Mother of the Screw Realm.

In this vast dimensional rift region, Second Realm time lifeforms are numerous, but those entering the Second Realm within a great apocalypse cycle are incredibly rare.

At least, Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong had only heard of such types of Second Realm time lifeforms, rarer even than Time Lords.

First Realm to Second Realm requires comprehending one’s own Chaotic Origin Dao, which as a fundamental level Dao, must be applicable to most parts of the dimensional rift region.

This requires time lifeforms to experience various dimensional spaces, traversing the vast dimensional rift region, making it difficult to comprehend an ’applicable’ Origin Dao confined to a single dimensional space.

This is why almost all Second Realm time lifeforms only achieve such understanding after leaving their home dimensional space and comprehending other dimensional spaces.

This is the norm for Second Realm time lifeforms.

"For ’Galaxy’ to repel Gray Ancestor, its strength must be formidable among Second Realm time lifeforms," Wan Chengkong remarked.

At least, he lacked confidence in making Gray Ancestor retreat; perhaps other factors, like not wanting to fully engage to prevent Mother of the Screw Realm and himself from capitalizing, contributed to Gray Ancestor’s retreat.

"Very formidable," Mother of the Screw Realm nodded.

They once spent ten pounds of Time Sand to purchase detailed information on conflicts involving Lin Yuan from Gray Ancestor.

Understanding the terrors of this Second Realm time lifeform, Gray Ancestor retreated not from hesitation but from simply feeling overpowered, avoiding further loss in battle.

"Huh? It’s unexpected for a madman like you to rate it so highly?" Wan Chengkong eyed Mother of the Screw Realm.

Mother of the Screw Realm’s madness was notorious among Second Realm time lifeforms.

"But no matter how strong, becoming a lord still requires time," Wan Chengkong stated.

Comprehending the Chaotic Origin Dao might involve insight or other factors, but entering the Third Realm and consolidating all personal timelines allows no shortcuts.

The future timelines are riddled with countless variables, and attempting to consolidate them traps many Second Realm peak time lifeforms.

"Indeed."

Mother of the Screw Realm nodded in agreement.

Among the vast dimensional rift, those entering Second Realm within a great apocalypse cycle often endured as much time becoming Time Lords as other Second Realm lifeforms.

"Hahaha, thinking about it this way makes me feel much better."

Wan Chengkong’s face broke into a smile.

Imagining an abnormality like ’Galaxy’ also needing to patiently streamline its timelines, possibly entangled in a single timeline for tens, hundreds, or thousands of great apocalypse cycles.

Wan Chengkong found a semblance of balance.

...

Chaos Void.

After discerning the essence of the Origin Dao of the Milky Way dimension, Lin Yuan returned to the Chaos Void in person.

"Future self."

Lin Yuan carefully observed his future timelines, with his future self guiding each timeline to quickly converge and consolidate.

"At the current rate of convergence, it will take approximately fifty to one hundred thousand years to fully consolidate, marking my true ascension to lordship."
